title: Not a great set long-term
text: Not a great set long-term. The edges of this set started to wear off in less than a year. About the same wear that occurred to my Calphalin set after 3-5 years. The main part if the pan is still usable and the Teflon hasn't "peeled" from the wear spots, but I would not buy this set again unless the price was a bargain. Overall the cooking appears to be even and the pans have not warped. However, they look significantly older than they are and I expect the damage to get worse with additional usage.
